About Me

I'm Ranjith Kumar C

VLSI Physical Design Engineer | RTL-to-GDSII | SoC Implementation

A self-driven VLSI Physical Design Engineer with a strong foundation in Digital Electronics and Static Timing Analysis. With 1.5+ years of hands-on experience, I specialize in RTL-to-GDSII implementation across 14nm and 32nm technologies, including a 2 GHz GPU core taken through complete PnR, with multi-voltage low-power design (UPF), DRC/LVS and PPA optimization using Synopsys and Cadence tools.

Proficient in the complete RTL-to-GDSII flow — floorplanning, placement, Clock Tree Synthesis, routing, and timing closure — with strong expertise in Static Timing Analysis and low-power multi-voltage architectures.

EDA Tools: Synopsys Fusion Compiler, Design Compiler, ICC2, PrimeTime; Cadence Innovus, Genus, Tempus; Calibre (Basics), Library Manager, Xilinx Vivado

Languages & Scripting: Verilog, TCL Scripting for EDA Automation, Linux Environment, PnR Flow Scripting

Tiny-GPU Physical Design – Multi-Core GPU Implementation (14nm)

Tiny-GPU Physical Design — Multi-Core GPU (14nm)

RTL-to-GDSII of a 4-core × 4-thread GPU on SAED14 EDK. Architected a multi-voltage UPF power intent. Closed 2 GHz timing with positive slack at ~54% utilization across 50,245 std-cells; fixed min-cap violations via SDC load correction and driver resizing.

14nm · November 2025 – January 2026

Raven SoC Physical Design – Multi-Voltage & Multi-Power Domain Implementation (14nm)

Raven SoC Physical Design — Multi-Voltage & Multi-Power Domain (14nm)

Full-chip SoC with dual power domains and multi-clock architecture. Re-architected floorplan, cutting DRC violations from 7,384 to 5,024. Integrated 4 hard macros in a 28,544 std-cell SoC using PNS strategies; closed hold after setup, with clean LVS.

RTL-to-GDSII · Floorplanning · Power Planning · PNS · STA · DC · ICC2 · Fusion Compiler

14nm FinFET · June 2025 – September 2025

RISC-V Processor Physical Design Implementation (14nm FinFET)

RISC-V Processor Physical Design — 14nm FinFET

Owned block-level implementation of a 14nm FinFET RISC-V core, from synthesis to signoff readiness. Three-domain multi-voltage design with isolation cells and level shifters. ~10,760 std-cells and 3 macros at 72.5% utilization; 500 MHz timing closure; DRCs cut from 1,923 to 542.

1×3 Packet Router — 32nm MOSFET

End-to-end ASIC physical implementation on 32nm MOSFET. Mapped 6,847 std-cells at 70% core utilization achieving zero DRC and clean LVS. Three-island multi-voltage low-power design (1.16V / 0.95V / 0.75V) with level shifters for cross-domain integrity.
